description: This file implements the Login feature for user authentication, including request validation, user credential verification, token generation, and response encapsulation.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Holds the user's email and password input data for login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Represents the login request command containing user data, implements IRequest for processing.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the login command ensuring presence of email and password.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles the login process: verifying credentials, generating token, and returning user data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the login request: retrieves user info, verifies password, generates JWT, and returns user envelope.
